Commentary.Commentary: ... RUN CHASE ...

Now the wicket is a decent one to bat on and Windies will back themselves to chase this down. However, we did see Namibia defend something similar in the first game of the World Cup and Scotland will know if they get early wickets, they are well and truly in this game. Can they do so?

West Indies were not that great with the new ball but post the 6, they really executed their plans well. The likes of Holder, Alzarri Joseph and Odean Smith were really good with the short balls. Alzarri Joseph and Jason Holder were easily the pick. Except for his last over Smith did a really good job. The likes of Obed McCoy and Mayers though went for a few. Still though, West Indies will be pleased with how they managed to pull things back.

Scotland have got themselves to a competitive score but pretty sure they would have wanted a lot more especially after the start they got off too. They were going at around 9 per over in the Powerplay but after the rain break, they just could not go on with the same momentum. They lost wickets at regular intervals and scoring was also not easy. A few batters in the middle order got off to starts but could not go on. Munsey played throughout but he too slowed down after the break and quite drastically. He did get to a half ton but he won't be very pleased with it. Still though, they have a decent score on the board.

EDGY FOUR! That flies off the outside edge and down to the third man fence! A boundary to end and that is a big last over. Scotland have touched the 160-run mark! This is full and outside off, Munsey swings, it goes off the outside edge and down to the third man fence.
WIDE! A boundary now will do too! Well wide outside off. Left alone.
FOUR! A gift, a full toss and Munsey puts it away! He slams it down the ground and it races away to the fence. Can he now hit a biggie and help his side cross the 160-run mark?
Just the one! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped but to covers.
Dots are godl! Shorter and outside off, Greaves slashes but misses.
On off, a yorker, it is jammed out towards cover for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap! A welcome boundary for Munsey and his side! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled wide of mid-wicket for a boundary. A boundary to begin the last. 160 is still possible.

Yes, he does! Just the two. Should have been only a single though! On middle, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket. They take one. The throw is a wayward one towards the keeper and another run is taken. Still though, a top penultimate over from Alzarri Joseph!
A yorker on off, this is jammed out through covers for one. Can he end the over well now?

That is brilliant from Pooran! Really good! Short and on off, Greaves looks to pull, it goes off the helmet to the right of Pooran who dives and stops it. He gets back to his feet again and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Had he hit, Munsey was gone. A leg bye in the end.

NOT OUT! That is a poor review! It has pitched outside leg. Windies have lost both their reviews now! This is full and on the pads. Munsey looks to play the paddle scoop but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but turned down. It rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken. It is reviewed but in vain. Just the one run from the first three balls.
A good short one now outside off, Munsey looks to cut but misses.

NOT OUT! The impact is outside leg! A good review in the end but Munsey will be disappointed he did not put that away! A full toss on the pads, George Munsey swings but misses to get hit on the thigh. An appeal and the finger is raised. Munsey reviews and replays show that he survives to fight another day.
A single to end! A good comeback by Obed McCoy in the latter half of the over. On middle, this is whipped towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Yet again is early down on oe knee, a slower one on middle, Greaves looks to sweep, he is through the shot early, It goes off the toe-end towards the off side for one.
Goes wide outside off, Greaves looks to go after it but misses.
TWO MORE! Yet again, Greaves gets into position early to play the sweep shot. This is short, he somehow pulls it wide of fine leg for two.

FOUR! Not sure what the fine leg fielder did there? Akeal Hosein has not had a good day in the field! He was pushed back to fine leg but he was standing quite ahead of the ropes. This is bowled short. Greaves goes for the pull, it flies off the top edge towards fine leg. Akeal Hosein runs in but then realises he has to go back. Too late as the ball goes over him and into the fence. Two boundaries to begin this over. Can they make this into a big over?

FOUR! That is nicely played! Chris Greaves goes down on one knee looking for the scoop. He is helped by Obed McCoy who bowls it short and down the leg side. Chris Greaves scoops it over the fielder for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, Greaves pulls it down to long on and takes one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for noe.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.

OUT! TIMBER! You miss, I hit! A little too quick for Leask and Alzarri Joseph has another one! He sees Leask make room and bowls a yorker on middle, Leask looks to carve it but misses. Really good stuff from Alzarri Joseph!
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one. Fifty for Munsey! He started off really well but has slowed down after the Powerplay. He though would hope he can help his side finish well.
WIDE! Way too short and down the leg side. Left alone. Wided.
Shorter in length again, Leask pulls, it goes more off the splice towards mid-wicket for one.
A leg bye to end! On the pads, Leask looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls no the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Another one on the shorter side, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
A run! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket.
Another short one, Leask pulls again but to mid on.
Two more! Goes after it straightaway! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over mid on for two.

OUT! TAKEN! Welcome wicket as the two were really going along nicely. Odean Smith strikes and this is a sharp catch! This is short and outside off, Calum MacLeod makes room and hammers it towards cover. King takes a sharp catch. Good little cameo from Calum MacLeod!
Commentary.Howout: c Brandon King b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: A single to end as this is pushed through covers.
On off, this is guided to point.
Well fielded! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to two.
FOUR! Lovely shot! The reverse sweep comes out, it is hit past point for a boundary. This is a really good knock from Calum MacLeod so far.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Two! On middle, this is hit through square leg for two.
A dot to end! Shorter and outside off, Calum MacLeod guides it to point.

FOUR! That is a powerful stroke! Consecutive boundaries and this is turning out to be a really good over for Scotland! This is full and on off, Calum MacLeod makes room and lifts it over cover for a boundary.

FOUR! Really nicely played! Good adjustment! He walks to the off side to play the paddle scoop, this is a slower one outside off. Calum MacLeod plays the paddle scoop, he manages to get it past the keeper and fine on the leg side for a boundary. 100 up.
On the shorter side, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one. 9 from the over then.
On the fuller side, Calum MacLeod strokes it through covers and takes one.
FOUR! Cracking pull shot and into the gap! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled wide of square leg for a boundary.
SHOT! Holder goes full after bowling the last one short. Calum MacLeod was ready for it, he pushes it back past the bowler for two.
Safe! Shorter again, Calum MacLeod looks to defend, this hits the splice and lobs on the off side. Lands short of point.
Shorter and slower on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Dot to end a really good over by Alzarri Joseph! On off, defended.
That is really quick! Unlucky to be called a wide but that was good pace! Short and on middle, this one zips through. Calum MacLeod somehow gets out of the way.

OUT! TAKEN! The short ball does the trick yet again! Alzarri Joseph strikes! The extra pace does the job. Shorter and on middle, Richie Berrington looks to pull but it hits the splice as he is late on the shot and lobs to mid-wicket. Kyle Mayers takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Mayers b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and on the body, Munsey pulls it towards deep square leg for one.

A direct hit and Richie Berrington would have been walking back! He was late to take off, maybe shook by the ball hitting him on the helmet! Shorter and on middle, Richie Berrington looks to pull, it goes off the top edge and hits the helmet. It rolls on the leg side. Munsey wants one, Richie Berrington is late in taking off. Mayers gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
On off, this is driven but to covers.
Shorter and outside off, George Munsey cuts it past point for one.
A dot to end then! Shorter and outside off, this is guided to point. A good over for Scotland.

SIX! That is massive, that is huge, huge hit! What connection, what sound and it is a welcome one for the Windies. Also, this shot shows how true this wicket is. On middle, flatter. Richie Berrington whacks it, he gets the middle and it sails over the mid-wicket fence.
Two more! Shorter and on off, this is pushed wide of long off for two.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut past point for one more.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

Not sure why the fielder did not go for the catch! Shorter and outside off, Richie Berrington slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge towards third man. Akeal Hosein runs back and across rather than ahead. He collects the ball on the bounce and also concedes an extra run. Two in total. Pooran is not happy and rightly so.
Another one on the shorter side, Munsey looks to pull, this goes off the glove too and towards fine leg for another one.
Shorter and on the body, Richie Berrington looks to pull, it goes off the splice towards mid on for one.
Length and outside off, a little bit of extra bounce. Richie Berrington looks to hit it over cover but misses.
Two more! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over mid-wicket for two.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Another one on the stumps, it is kept out. Another successful over for Holder.
On middle, defended.
Another run! On the shorter side, this is pushed through covers for another one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Another wicket for Holder and the braek has worked wonders. Run scoring has been tough after that and Windies have gotten two wickets too. A short one on middle, this gets big on the batter. Cross looks to pull but fails to get on top of the bounce, it goes off the splice and the fielder at mid on, Shamarh Brooks moves to his left and takes it nicely.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: Angled into the pads, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on middle, this one holds in the surface a touch, it is mistimed to mid on.
On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for another single.
Tip and run! Length and on off, Cross plays it on the off side and takes a single.
Another one on the shorter side, this is pulled wide of square leg for one.
Shorter and into the body, this is pulled towards fine leg for one more.
Shorter and outside off, Munsey cuts it through point for one.
A single to end then! Shorter and on off, Munsey pushes it through covers and takes one.
Very full and on off, Munsey drives it hard but finds cover.
Good length and on off, defended.
Cross is off the mark! Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.

OUT! TIMBER! That is a beauty! Why has Jason Holder not been given the ball all this while? Makes an impact straightaway and breaks the opening stand. That is exactly the start Windies would have wanted after the break. This is on a length, it lands outside off and jags back in. Jones looks to flick it on the leg side but misses, it hits the pad and then goes onto hit the stumps. A good opening stand comes to an end. The two laid the platform. Will Scotland build on this now or will Windies capitalize?
Full and on the pads, George Munsey looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side for one. Leg bye.

NOT OUT! The impact is outside off and Windies lose a review! Munsey walks down the track. Obed McCoy goes very full and gets it to shape back in from outside off. Munsey fails to put bat on ball as he tries to flick and gets hit on the pad. A huge appeal but it is turned down. The batters take one as it rolls on the off side. Pooran reviews but in vain. Leg bye signaled. A good Powerplay for Scotland. They are 54 for 0 after it.
Review! An appeal for LBW but turned down! Pooran is quick to review but the impact seemsan issue. The Windies' players are already back to their positions as they too feel the impact is outside off.
First run after the delay! Fuller and on off, this is driven hard to mid off for one.
A dot to begin after the break! Shorter and outside off, Jones looks to cut but is beaten.
The players are out in the middle and we are all set to resume. NO OVERS LOST! Obed McCoy will continue his over. Here we go...
UPDATE 1034 IST (0504 GMT) - The news just gets better! We have a time! Play is expected to begin at 1045 IST (0515 GMT).
UPDATE 1030 IST (0500 GMT) - GOOD NEWS! The rain has stopped and the covers are coming off. It should not be long before we resume.

We still have some time before we start losing some overs! For now though, the drizzle remains and the covers are firmly on. There seems to be a strong wind blowing so we are hoping it clears quickly.

The plays now make their way off! They are not rushing into the dressing room so that might be signs that it is not that heavy and they expect it to pass by. For now though, we are in for a delay as the covers are on. Let us hpe it is a short one. Also, the Windies might now mind this break, the openers were really giving their bowlers a hammering and a break can just take that momentum away from the batters.

NOT OUT! It is clipping the top of middle! Umpire's call! Not a bad review by the Windies. They retain it but do not get the wicket. This is on middle, Munsey walks across and looks to flick it on the leg side but misses. It hits the thigh pad. A huge appeal but turned down. Windies review but replays show that the on-field call will remain.
Review time! A loud shout for an LBW is turned down. Windies review. Looks high.
It has started to rain and it is coming down quite hard. The umpires though are willing to continue. The groundsmen are seen getting ready.
Good length and on off, Munsey pushes it to covers.
On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
A single to end! Fifty up for Scotland and it comes up within the Powerplay. Another good over for them. Jones pushes the last ball down to long on and takes one.
On the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Two more! On middle, Jones shows the full face of the bat and lofts it down towards long on for two.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Brilliant stroke! Jones steps out, he makes room and then manages to hit it past the cover fielder for a lovely boundary.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked down to long on for one.

That is well fielded! Two to end yet another big over for the batting side! Shorter and on the body, Munsey pulls it towards short fine leg. The fielder dives to his left and gets a hand to it. Saves two for his side.

FOUR! Thumped down the ground! Powerful stroke! Length and on off, Munsey stands tall and hits it hard past the mid off fielder and into the fence. Three boundaries in a row. Scotland are off to a flier.
FOUR! Two in a row! Through the leg side this time! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Slapped away! Width on offer and Munsey cashes in! Outside off, this is slapped through covers and this one races away to the fence.
Jones makes room! This is shorter and on middle, he looks to hit it down the ground but it goes off the splice towards mid off for one.
Good length and on off, this is guided to point.

FOUR! The over starts with a boundary and ends with one too! 16 from the over. A very risky but a clever shot. Shorter and on off, Munsey makes room, he manages to upper cut it past the keeper and into the third man fence. Scotland will be very happy with the start they are off too.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
Jones makes room, Mayers goes short and on the body, he looks to pull but it goes off the glove towards point for one.
Angled into the pads, Munsey looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Goes full, almost a yorker, Munsey jams it out towards cover.
WIDE! Mayers is under pressure here! Munsey makes room, this is banged in short and on the body. Munsey ducks under but wided.

FOUR! Two in a row! Mayers is looking for that outswing and hence, is starting from the leg pole. No swing and it is easy pickings for Munsey who yet again flicks it wide of deep square leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Whipped away! On the pads, Munsey loves it there, he whips it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. Mayers is leaking boundaries here.
He can't but just the one from the over! Tidy stuff! On the pads, this is tucked through mid-wicket for one.
Pushes it through on off, Munsey pushes it to cover. Can he bowl a maiden?
4 dots in a row! Fuller and around off, this is hit to covers.
Munsey now makes room, he is followed, Akeal Hosein darts it through. Munsey works it to mid on.
Both the batters have come out with intent! Munsey looks to play the reverse sweep, this is fired outside off. Munsey misses.
This is very full and outside off, George Munsey fails to jam it out.

PUT DOWN! Tough chance though! That had to stick! Jones yet again uses his feet, this is fuller and on middle, it is driven back firmly towards the bowler. Mayers gets a hand to it but can't hold on. Three dots to end but a good first over for the batting side.
Goes slightly fuller again and gets it to shape back in. Jones works it to short fine leg.
Mayers drags his length back, Jones defends it to point.

FOUR! Two in a row and this is a shot full of confidence! Jones now takes a few steps ahead and makes this into a full toss, he does not look to hit it hard but just times it past cover. The outfield is quite fast and it races away to the fence.
FOUR! Jones is off the mark in style! First boundary of the game! Mayers looks to bowl an inswinging yorker but ends up serving a full toss, it is driven through covers for a boundary.
Some swing for Kyle Mayers! Munsey though plays it well and he and Scotland are underway! Length and on off, it shapes away. Munsey guides it through point and takes one.

Done and dusted with the Anthems and now it is time for the action to begin! The Windies players make their way out to the middle. They are followed by George Munsey and Michael Jones. Kyle Mayers to begin. Here we go...
We are moments away from the first ball! The players make their way out for the National Anthems! It will Scotland singing their first and then West Indies will follow.
SCOTLAND (PLAYING XI) - George Munsey, Michael Jones, Matthew Cross (WK), Richie Berrington (C), Calum MacLeod, Chris Greaves, Michael Leask, Mark Watt, Josh Davey, Safyaan Sharif, Brad Wheal.
WEST INDIES (PLAYING XI) - Kyle Mayers, Evin Lewis, Brandon King, Shamarh Brooks, Nicholas Pooran (WK/C), Rovman Powell, Jason Holder, Odean Smith, Akeal Hosein, Alzarri Joseph, Obed McCoy.

PITCH REPORT - Ian Bishop says it is quite cold and there is a strong wind blowing. Adds it is a long boundary down the ground but the square is shorter. Samuel Badree then says there is good amount of grass and adds it is a hard pitch. Mentions there could good bounce and it can come onto the bat nicely. Reckons there could be a lot of runs.

Richie Berrington says they wanted to bowl first as there might be moisutre. States they learnt a lot from the last World Cup and as a team they will look to work hard and do well in this one. Informs about his side.
Nicholas Pooran says it is a new pitch and they want to see how it plays. Adds they are motivated, they are taking nothing for granted and want to do well. Informs about his team.
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and ELECTED TO BOWL!

The Windies are surely the favourites heading into this encounter but we just saw yesterday an upset can never be ruled out. Scotland do have some quality players and on their day can challenge any side. Can they upset the odds and beat the Windies? We will find out.
